title: DARS: Dual-Level Credit Assignment RL with Structured Reasoning for Instruction-Based Image Editing
abstract: Instruction-based image editing uses a planner-renderer pipeline: a vision-language model (VLM) first converts the instruction into an edit plan, and a diffusion model then executes that plan. Training such systems with only final-image rewards is inefficient because a poor edit does not reveal whether additional optimization should place more emphasis on the planner or the renderer, and even planner-dominant cases remain difficult to localize within a free-form reasoning trace. We present DARS, a reinforcement learning framework for dual-level credit assignment in this two-stage setting. Across modules, multi-plan multi-render rollouts estimate between-plan and within-plan reward variability for soft module routing, while rollout mean rewards provide hardness estimates for an adaptive curriculum. Within the planner, a four-field structured reasoning output enables a prefix-gated reward and token-level advantage reweighting, turning outcome-level feedback into localized supervision. Experiments on five benchmarks show that DARS outperforms a Joint~RL baseline with the same backbone, data, reward model, and rollout budget, with the largest gains on reasoning-intensive edits.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2608.20161v1 全文整理；本地 PDF 共 36 页，SHA-256 57996c92e1b76d7ffefeebd200cab5c7f28323ed560d28b7cf6c6d633f32150b，并视觉核验第 1、4、6、8 页。
analysis.ideaZh: DARS 用多plan×多render rollouts的between/within variance决定planner/renderer软路由，再把planner输出固定成Modify/Preserve/Overall/Tips四槽，用prefix-gated reward与token advantage把final-image反馈定位到具体planning slot；五个benchmarks均优于matched Joint RL。
methodFlow: VLM planner生成多个四槽structured plans
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 同时命中image editing与visual design agents；render feedback如何归因到planner/action是核心可迁移问题。
analysis.evidenceZh: DARS用multi-plan/multi-render variance做cross-module routing，并用structured prefix-gated rewards做within-planner credit。（Figure 3 and Sec. 4, p. 4）；作者报告matched Joint RL control之上，DARS在KRIS-Bench +8.57、RISE-Bench +1.80，五个benchmark均最佳。（Tables 1-4, pp. 6-8）；每example需M×K rollouts，成本高；variance与post-render scores依赖reward model，planner和renderer同时失败时credit仍不稳。（Limitations, p. 8）
analysis.caveatZh: 作者明确列出rollout成本、reward依赖、双模块同时失败与video/multi-turn扩展尚未解决。；每example需M×K rollouts，成本高；variance与post-render scores依赖reward model，planner和renderer同时失败时credit仍不稳。；所有实验数字均为作者报告；本项目没有独立复现。
analysis.motivationZh: 论文解决planner-renderer image editing只有final reward时无法分配模块责任的问题。跨模块variance估计软路由与sample hardness；within planner用structured slots、checklist reward和causal prefix gate细化credit。10K training examples、相同backbone/data/reward/rollout matched control、五benchmarks和routing pseudo-label validation支持机制，但M×K rollouts成本高且reward-model bias仍在。
analysis.methodZh: 同时解决跨module credit和planner内部token credit，且用rollout statistics而非额外人工failure labels进行路由。 方法流程：VLM planner生成多个四槽structured plans → 每个plan由diffusion renderer生成多个edits → between/within-plan variance估计模块责任与hardness → prefix-gated slot rewards重加权planner tokens → soft-routed GRPO分别更新planner与renderer。
analysis.experimentsZh: 10K examples；Qwen3-VL-4B planner、Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 renderer；五benchmarks、matched joint RL与多个edit/planning baselines。 作者报告：作者报告matched Joint RL control之上，DARS在KRIS-Bench +8.57、RISE-Bench +1.80，五个benchmark均最佳。（Tables 1-4, pp. 6-8） Baseline coverage：11种editors加matched backbone/data/reward/rollout control；但reward-model evaluator仍同源且无真实user preference study。 Ablation：curriculum、soft/hard/no routing、四槽结构、prefix gate与routing-signal对GPT-5 pseudo-label discrimination。
analysis.insightZh: 同时解决跨module credit和planner内部token credit，且用rollout statistics而非额外人工failure labels进行路由。 matched control、五benchmark与credit ablation完整，是本轮最相关的视觉agent训练工作之一，建议深读。
